title: Source-backed Context Record
description: An explicitly reviewed reference record, never an instruction or proof of semantic correctness. Runtime additionally checks byte limits, path containment, symlinks, source hashes, timestamp ordering, age, expiry, and conflicts.

key.description: Stable semantic subject shared by competing records; equal keys with different text or kind in overlapping scopes are quarantined.

scope.description: Repository-relative file or directory scopes; a single dot means the whole project. No glob syntax.

text.description: Concise reviewed fact or decision. Runtime limits UTF-8 encoding to 4096 bytes. Exclude secrets and transcripts.

verified_by.description: Reviewing person or evidence-producing process; a recorded attribution, not authenticated identity. Runtime limits UTF-8 encoding to 120 bytes.

sha256.description: Hash of the complete current file bytes, computed when its claim was checked.
